in the grey in-between of an industrial town between Saint-Étienne and Lyon, Moravie grew up with music as her only door out. From rap to punk, it was The Hacker's Rêves Mécaniques that struck like a blade: a mechanical coldness that frees as much as it confines. She then sank into post-punk, goth, cold and new wave.

A DJ since 2018, she is now a singular voice of the French underground: resident at Sonic in Lyon, two years on Radio FG, a regular at Le Sucre and Nuits Sonores 2025, and a mixtape on Clan Destine Records. She has shared the booth with Perc, Miss Kittin and Dave Clarke.

Her sets are rituals: coldwave catching fire, dark disco flirting with EBM, martial percussion against the heat of bodies. Eros and Thanatos, giallo and Gabrielle Wittkop. She gathers as much as she plays, with her collective Dark Entry in Lyon and now in Marseille, keeping the French EBM scene alive.
